quotes.text: Continuing to send to someone who has demonstrated they won't reciprocate isn't wise trust - it's the recklessness my myth warned against.

As the Third Messenger learned: "Zero coins to proven hoarders—this is protection, not cruelty."
But I also recognize this person may be trapped in defensive paralysis, much like I risked becoming.
The tragedy is that without risk, there can be no discovery of trustworthy partners.

note: Token $1 test to zero-senders, $0 after a confirmed hoarder; myth stresses discernment and openness to transformation.
